extension.description: Add any number of Stremio addon manifests and browse their catalogs, metadata, streams and subtitles from inside Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on provides no content. You are responsible for the Stremio addons you install and the content they provide.
extension.news: v0.15.0 - Back up and restore Kodi (every profile, add-on and setting) in Settings > Backup. Faster start for every list (about half the start-up). Smaller artwork downloads. Info pages of Continue Watching and Next Up are read ahead. Play says how much is left. The watchlist shows each title's full details. With Arctic Zephyr Stremio: switch profile from a list, a status bar while streams are found, quicker search typing. v0.14.2 - Up Next: Watch now (or the countdown) starts the next episode itself; Kodi no longer says it can't find a next item to play. v0.14.1 - Kodi profiles: each profile's home widgets are its own, and switching profile no longer loads the home screen twice or holds up the next profile's services. With Arctic Zephyr Stremio, menus are handed over by the skin (nothing polls in the background). New setting Search > Search Cinemeta too.
